fields.label: Title
fields.description: A short name this entry will be known by.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Risk: something that could go wrong. Opportunity: something that could be gained.

fields.label: Department
fields.options:
Management
Quality
Production
Sales & Marketing
Purchase
Accounts
fields.description: The department that owns this entry.

fields.label: Source / Process Area
fields.description: Where it was spotted: a process area, an audit, a review, customer feedback.

fields.label: Process / Activity
fields.description: The specific process or activity it concerns.

fields.label: Issue Description
fields.description: What is happening today that gives rise to this risk or opportunity.

fields.label: Existing Controls
fields.description: What is already in place today to manage this.

fields.label: Type of Issue
fields.description: Internal: within the company. External: market, suppliers, regulations.

fields.label: Interested Parties
fields.description: Who is affected: customers, employees, suppliers, regulators.

fields.label: Risk / Opportunity Statement
fields.description: One sentence: what could go wrong, or what could be gained.

fields.label: Severity (S)
fields.description: How bad if it happens: 1 Insignificant → 5 Critical.

fields.label: Benefit Factor (B)
fields.description: How much is gained: 1 Very Low → 5 Very High.

fields.label: Probability (P)
fields.description: How likely: 1 Rare → 5 Almost Certain.

fields.label: Score
fields.description: Calculated on save: Severity × Probability for a risk, Benefit × Probability for an opportunity.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Set from the score: 1–5 Low · 6–10 Medium / Moderate · 11–15 High · 16–25 Very High / Excellent.

fields.label: Action Plan
fields.description: What will be done to reduce the risk or seize the opportunity.

fields.label: Responsibility
fields.description: The position accountable for the action.

fields.label: Target Date
fields.description: When the action should be complete.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Open until the action starts, In Progress while it runs, Closed when done and verified.

fields.label: Last Reviewed On
fields.description: When this entry was last confirmed still valid.

fields.label: Seed Batch
fields.description: Set only on records created by a seed import. Hand-created records leave this empty and are never touched by a purge.
